summary.en: Boulevard City's searchlight beams: soft shafts of light 900 m tall that sway slowly over the plaza at night, each on its own phase, in a row 4 m apart.
summary.ar: حزم الكشافات الضوئية في بوليفارد سيتي: أعمدة ضوء ناعمة بارتفاع 900 م تتمايل ببطء فوق الساحة ليلًا، لكل منها إيقاعها، في صف بمسافة 4 م بينها.

source.symbol: makeSearchlights (vfx/searchlights.js); the sway in the frame loop (main.js 1579)

defaults.note: vfx/searchlights.js makeSearchlights: the six tallest screen buildings (bStyle 1) get one beam each, 1 m above the roof (bH + 1); one InstancedMesh of ConeGeometry(24, 900, 24, 1, true) flipped tip-down at the lamp; MeshBasicNodeMaterial additive, depthWrite false, DoubleSide, forceSinglePass, fog off, renderOrder 2; colour vec3(0.78, 0.85, 1.0) (linear: #e5edff is its nearest sRGB byte), opacity uNight x 0.07 x |normalView.z|^2 x (1 - y / 900)^1.6 x smoothstep(0, 0.02, y / 900). main.js 1579: rotation (sin(n x 0.00021 + ph) x 0.35, 0, cos(n x 0.00017 + ph x 1.3) x 0.35), n in ms, ph = k x 1.7. Here a row 4 m apart, k = 0, 1, 2, ...
